Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

All-purpose expansion anchor for use in medium weight applications. Product diameter 18mm, bolt size M12 and drill diameter 16mm. Integral collapse feature ensures maximum clamping force is applied to the fixture. Ideal for applications such as radiators, signs, stadium seating, satellite dishes, wall plates, shutter and garage doors.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Brickwork, Blockwork & Stone
